frame:
(metres, z up, origin on the countertop below the body's front-left corner):
  +x  to the right along the front face
  +y  into the microwave (front face of the body at y = 0, door in front of it)
  +z  up
The door joint is `door_hinge`; q = 0 closed, q > 0 opens it outward to the left.

body_depth.source: measured: 31-32 cm overall incl. the 3.6 cm door, without the back bump; single depth frames give 30-31.6 cm

body_height.source: measured: 27.5-28 cm counter to top, minus the feet; depth frames 27.9 cm

cavity_depth.source: measured at the edges and corners; reaches past the body into a bump on the back

cavity_recess_depth.source: measured, centre of the back wall

cavity_recess_inset.source: guess from the door-open photo, recess edge to cavity edge

back_shell.source: guess, sheet thickness of the back bump

cavity_left_offset.source: measured, cavity to the hinge-side outer edge

cavity_floor_above_body_bottom.source: photo (door-open view), scaled to the 27 cm body

hinge_friction.source: guess, N m: a light hinge, as the real one (do not stiffen it to hide the arm brushing the door)

handle_x.source: photo, bar centre from the hinge-side edge (~1.3 cm in from the door's free edge)

handle_offset.source: measured, door face to bar axis

handle_post_spacing.source: measured, between the two door-to-bar posts
